source_snapshot.items: KVM - Status check during power off
source_snapshot.procedure: Power off the SUT, navigate to KVM and launch it.
source_snapshot.criteria: KVM status displays Connected and the main screen displays POWER OFF while the SUT is off.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 10 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes IPMI power off plus KVM screenshot but does not define graceful versus hard-off, independent off proof or stale-frame control.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; preserves literal visual evidence and adds target, shutdown, session-freshness and recovery gates.

old_problem: The source leaves the shutdown method, independent actual-off oracle, exact KVM display oracle, stale-frame detection and final power state unspecified; DeepSeek's unconditional chassis power off could interrupt work and a Connected label alone could falsely pass cached video.
disposition_reason: The purpose and two required observations are unambiguous. ED-06/15/19/20/24/30 allow the exact SUT, approved graceful or hard-off method, display latency/oracle and recovery to remain runtime project inputs. Independent host-power evidence plus a fresh KVM session and real timestamped visual evidence prevent stale-screen substitution without inventing OEM behavior.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2223, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2224 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00007-V001 / 6bc9da49c7fb9a8f was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind the exact SUT/BMC/KVM firmware and prove console-to-host association before any power action.
Drain workloads and choose graceful shutdown by default; a hard-off requires separate explicit authorization and is never inferred from the DeepSeek example.

Prove actual host-off independently, then launch a new KVM session and correlate its session identifier/timestamp, literal Connected state and platform-approved POWER OFF display within the approved latency.
A cached last frame, wrong-host console, blank/no-signal state without an approved equivalence, or Connected without the required visual cannot pass.
Close without keyboard, mouse, virtual-media, reset or power control, restore the approved final state and preserve BMC/SEL/session evidence.
Stop on wrong target, failed shutdown, KVM loss, stale/frozen image or unexpected power behavior; no automatic retry/cycle.
No power-off, KVM launch/input, restoration, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: KVM Connected and fresh POWER OFF display while host power is off
test_case.purpose: Verify that the correct BMC KVM service remains Connected while the managed host is independently proven off and presents the approved fresh POWER OFF visual state rather than stale video or another host's console.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/KVM firmware, client and console-to-host identity
Approved graceful or hard-off method, workload drain and independent off-state oracle
Literal Connected and POWER OFF/approved equivalent visual oracle, latency and stale-frame method
Authorized KVM session, final power state and BMC/console recovery
test_case.test_command: After separate approval and workload drain, perform the approved host shutdown, prove actual power-off independently, launch a fresh KVM session for the verified BMC, and capture synchronized session/status plus timestamped visual evidence showing Connected and the approved POWER OFF state. Send no console input or media/power action; restore the signed final state afterward.
test_case.expected_result: The independently verified powered-off host's fresh KVM session remains Connected and displays the exact approved POWER OFF state within latency, with no stale/wrong-host frame; the requested final power state and BMC/KVM health are restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires correlated actual-off evidence, fresh-session identity, literal Connected status, real timestamped POWER OFF visual evidence and successful final-state recovery. Wrong target, missing off proof, disconnected KVM, stale/frozen/ambiguous display, unapproved blank/no-signal substitution or failed recovery is FAIL. Missing runtime bindings blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target, drain, power method, off oracle, display oracle/latency, session security, final state and recovery are signed.
Prefer graceful shutdown; hard-off is separate one-shot authorization.
No KVM input, virtual media, reset/power widget, log clearing or automatic retry.
Stop on identity, shutdown, session, display or power anomaly and preserve evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash plus SUT/BMC/KVM firmware/client and target association
Drain and authorization, shutdown action/response and independent actual-off proof
Fresh session ID/timestamp, Connected status and timestamped POWER OFF screenshot/video
Stale-frame controls, BMC/SEL/session events, restored final power/KVM health and recovery record
test_case.recovery: On a shutdown or KVM anomaly, do not cycle or retry. Preserve logs and the current display; use the approved console/power recovery path to reach the signed final state and verify BMC/KVM health.

source_conflict.reason: The row consistently requires Connected plus POWER OFF while host power is off; missing runtime shutdown and visual details are not conflicting requirements.

blocked.reason: Purpose, operation and evidence channels are clear; target, shutdown, visual oracle and recovery are parameterizable prerequisites.
